To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose and construct the first fully secure predicate-hiding IPI-CC scheme, which is the first fully secure SIPE scheme.

we propose a definition of predicate-hidding IPE in a PKI, and give the first fully secure scheme that is comparably as secure as the best attribute-hiding not-predicate-hiding IPE scheme and that is comparable in efficiency.

the proposed IPE scheme is the first one that is fully secure, and the first one to be secure against an adaptive chosen-ciphertext attacker, in the sense that the scheme can be used in the real-world setting.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the first full security for inner product encryption in a public key and symmetric key setting, which may have applications in privacy-preserving data mining and cloud computing.

a new notion of predicate-hiding IBE, a new definition of predicate-hidden inner product encryption in the public key and symmetric key settings, and the first fully secure predicate-hiding IFE schemes in both settings.
the first fully secure public key inner product encryption in a public key IPE-CC and its conversion SIPE.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have proposed the first IPE-CC schemes that are fully secure, and have presented a new technique that enables us to achieve shorter public and secret key lengths.
we present the first fully attribute-hiding and predicate-hiding IFE scheme in a public-key setting.
we have proposed and constructed the first predicate-hiding IBE and IPE schemes in a public key PKI setting, and the first fully secure SIPE scheme in the sense of Waters.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we present the first predicate- and attribute hiding IPE in a fully secure manner in the public key and symmetric key settings respectively.

we propose a reasonable and useful definition for predicate-hiding IBE in a public key and present a fully secure IBE scheme with the same efficiency as existing attribute-hidding not predicate-hiding schemes.

we present the first fully-secure IPE scheme in the sense of both Shen, Shi, and Waters and Okamoto, Takashima, which is comparably as compact as existing attribute-holding not predicate-hiding ones, and is fully secure against a malicious PKG.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the predicate-hiding property of inner product encryption can be achieved in a public key system with the same efficiency as the existing attribute-hiding ones, which has been an open problem for a decade.
the multi-system proof technique is useful in designing fully secure attribute-hiding encryption schemes in a public key or symmetric key setting.
the multi-system proof technique is a powerful tool for proving security of public key encryption schemes.
